snippet.title: [Steam/Nintendo Switch] 'MONOWAVE' Launch Trailer
snippet.description:
Out Wednesday, September 16! The emotional puzzle-action adventure MONOWAVE is now available on Steam & Nintendo Switch™!

Become "Mono," the guardian spirit of emotions, and set out on a journey to soothe four rampant emotions: Happiness, Sadness, Anger, and Anxiety.

【Game Features】
・Unleash Emotions: Switch between four emotions and utilize unique abilities to solve puzzle-filled stages.
・Warm Worldview: Enchanting visuals crafted in a nostalgic scratch-art style.
・Heart-Touching Story: Connect with unique inhabitants and heal a broken world.
